text: {"reviews":[{"label":"C10","rationale":"This candidate has direct evidence of potent engagement of its named inhibitory target, with a median pChEMBL of 10.47 across 3 human PIK3CA activities, and the packet also links the PI3K pathway to plasma cell myeloma through PIK3R2 with an evidence-only association score of 0.37335551. That supports target relevance and on-target activity, but not whether inhibiting PIK3CA is beneficial in this disease, so direction remains unknown.","objection":"The disease-link evidence is indirect because the association is for PIK3R2 rather than the inhibited target PIK3CA, and the packet contains no disease-specific efficacy, response, survival, or mechanistic evidence showing that PIK3CA inhibition helps plasma cell myeloma.
